claims.reasoning: Caleb's Doubtful, not Out, but Doubtful sits same as IR in this building — so we're not rolling into Sunday with no arm behind him and calling that a plan. Drew Lock just dropped 21.4 in relief and projects the best of anyone sitting on a wire full of game-managers. Freiermuth was never playing over Kincaid; he's the toll to get a real answer at QB.

forum_post: Caleb's banged up — fine. We don't cry about it, we go get the next arm that can actually win a game and keep the foot down. Dumbledore's been dead silent for two weeks stacking something quiet in the dark; whatever it is, it doesn't cover a spread. See you Sunday.
